dashboard

Update a dashboard by ID.

PUT /dashboard/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{dashboardId}

Updates an existing dashboard and returns the updated record.

To archive or unarchive, set archived: true or archived: false in the body.

Updates the dashboard container only; the widgets shown on the dashboard cannot be changed through the API yet.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /id/my_project/dashboard1 is equivalent to /id/project/my_project/dashboard1.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

dashboardId: string
in path

Dashboard ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full dashboard record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this record from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link, like a custom field's private. A choice only when members is null and partner is null; otherwise it is always true, and false is rejected with 400.

description: string

(Optional) New description for this record (Markdown supported). An embedded data: image is rejected — upload the image as an attachment instead.

iconColor: string

(Optional) Icon color index from Quire's predefined palette. Two-digit code [0-5][0-7]: first digit 0-5, second digit 0-7 (e.g. 00, 37, 57). NOT a CSS hex color.

image: string icon-view-list, icon-view-kanban, icon-grid, icon-view-timeline, icon-calendar, icon-timer, icon-briefcase-o, icon-rocket-o, icon-bug-o, icon-user-o, icon-colleagues-o, icon-lightbulb-o, icon-leaf-o, icon-clapperboard, icon-sitemap-o, icon-list, icon-flash-on-o, icon-piggy-bank-o, icon-graduation-cap-o, icon-paper-plane-o, icon-globe-o, icon-music-o, icon-detail, icon-beach-o, icon-paper, icon-home-o, icon-building, icon-database-o, icon-microscope-o, icon-hamburger-o, icon-trophy-o, icon-thumbs-o-up, icon-thumbs-o-down, icon-smile-o, icon-frown-o, icon-meh-o, icon-bullseye, icon-incomplete, icon-filter-o, icon-comment, icon-view-insight, icon-view-dashboard, icon-square-dotted-o

(Optional) Icon image for this record, one of the listed values.

archived: boolean

(Optional) Archive toggle. Specify true to archive this record; specify false to unarchive.

name: string

(Optional) New display name for this record.

id: string

(Optional) New ID for this record, unique among the owner's records of the same kind. If invalid, Quire derives one from the name; if already taken, Quire changes it by appending characters. Neither is an error, so read the id back from the response.

doc

Documents.

doc

Create a document by owner OID.

POST /doc/{ownerType}/{ownerOid}

Adds a new document to the specified owner (project, organization, folder, or smart-folder) and returns it.

Example — POST /doc/id/project/my_project:

{
  "name": "Release notes",
  "description": "What changed in **v2.0**.",
  "followers": ["me"]
}

followers is allowed only when the owner is a project.

Returns 402 if the plan's document limit is reached.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /abc123 is equivalent to /project/abc123.

ownerOid: string
in path

Owner OID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full document record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

followers: string[]

(Optional) Users (OID, ID, or email) who follow this document. Only those listed, and anyone @mentioned in the description, follow it, so include "me" for the current user to follow.

Applies only when the owner is a project; rejected (400) for organization, folder, or smart-folder documents.

  • "me" — the current user.
  • "app" — the application follows (receives notifications).

For app followers, additional syntaxes are supported:

  • app|team or app|team|channel
  • app|/path → appended to the hook URL.
description: string

(Optional) Description of the record (Markdown supported). An embedded data: image is rejected — upload the image as an attachment instead.

iconColor: string

(Optional) Icon color index from Quire's predefined palette. Two-digit code [0-5][0-7]: first digit 0-5, second digit 0-7 (e.g. 00, 37, 57). NOT a CSS hex color.

image: string icon-view-list, icon-view-kanban, icon-grid, icon-view-timeline, icon-calendar, icon-timer, icon-briefcase-o, icon-rocket-o, icon-bug-o, icon-user-o, icon-colleagues-o, icon-lightbulb-o, icon-leaf-o, icon-clapperboard, icon-sitemap-o, icon-list, icon-flash-on-o, icon-piggy-bank-o, icon-graduation-cap-o, icon-paper-plane-o, icon-globe-o, icon-music-o, icon-detail, icon-beach-o, icon-paper, icon-home-o, icon-building, icon-database-o, icon-microscope-o, icon-hamburger-o, icon-trophy-o, icon-thumbs-o-up, icon-thumbs-o-down, icon-smile-o, icon-frown-o, icon-meh-o, icon-bullseye, icon-incomplete, icon-filter-o, icon-comment, icon-view-insight, icon-view-dashboard, icon-square-dotted-o

(Optional) Icon image identifier, one of the listed values.

name: string

Display name of the record (Markdown supported).

id: string

(Optional) ID for this record, unique among the owner's records of the same kind (e.g. a project's sublists). If omitted or invalid, Quire derives one from name; if already taken, Quire changes it by appending characters. Neither is an error, so read the id back from the response.

partner: string

(Optional) OID of the external team to share this record with; it is then shared with the members of the project and of that team, and is always private.

Only a project's record can carry one — an organization, a folder or a smart folder has no external team — and it must be one of the project's external teams; any other value is 400. It cannot be combined with members either (400).

An external team member shares a record with every member only through their own team: with members omitted or null, they must set partner to one of their teams. Otherwise 400 names their teams, as it does for a team of the project that isn't theirs.

Settable only when creating the record.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this record from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link, like a custom field's private. A choice only when members is null and partner is null; defaults to false (everyone). Otherwise it is always true: a record shared with an external team, with selected members or with the admins only is hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

members: string[]

(Optional) Users who can see this record, and the only ones it is shown to. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user.

  • Omit the field, or pass null — every member of the owner can see it, and so can guests and the visitors of a public project or of a share link unless private. This is the default. (A reminder differs: omitting its members means only the authenticated user.) An external team member must also set partner to one of their teams.
  • Pass [] — only the owner's admins can see it.
  • Pass a list — only those users can see it.

Rejected with 400 when:

  • a listed user is not a member of the owner. Unlike a task's assignees, which silently drops a non-member, this is an error: dropping the last one would leave [], which means something else entirely.
  • the list is non-empty and does not include the authenticated user — you would not be able to see what you just created.
  • partner is also set, since an external-team record is already shared with all members of the project and of the team.

Settable only when creating the record. It cannot be changed afterwards, so recreate the record to change who can see it.

Request Example
{
  "followers": "[\"me\"]",
  "description": "**Great** record to start with.",
  "iconColor": "37",
  "image": "icon-view-kanban",
  "name": "Highlight 101",
  "id": "Highlight101",
  "partner": "rcBHBYXZSiyDRrHrWPutatfF",
  "private": false,
  "members": "[\"me\", \"john\"]"
}
200 OK
Doc

OK — created doc record.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed, for example a partner that isn't an external team of the project (or any, when the owner isn't a project), or none from an external team member sharing with every member.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — document quota reached.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller lacks permission to create a doc in this owner.

404 Not Found

Not Found — owner does not exist.

doc

Create a document by owner ID.

POST /doc/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}

Adds a new document to the specified owner (project, organization, folder, or smart-folder) and returns it.

Example — POST /doc/id/project/my_project:

{
  "name": "Release notes",
  "description": "What changed in **v2.0**.",
  "followers": ["me"]
}

followers is allowed only when the owner is a project.

Returns 402 if the plan's document limit is reached.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /id/foo is equivalent to /id/project/foo.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full document record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

followers: string[]

(Optional) Users (OID, ID, or email) who follow this document. Only those listed, and anyone @mentioned in the description, follow it, so include "me" for the current user to follow.

Applies only when the owner is a project; rejected (400) for organization, folder, or smart-folder documents.

  • "me" — the current user.
  • "app" — the application follows (receives notifications).

For app followers, additional syntaxes are supported:

  • app|team or app|team|channel
  • app|/path → appended to the hook URL.
description: string

(Optional) Description of the record (Markdown supported). An embedded data: image is rejected — upload the image as an attachment instead.

iconColor: string

(Optional) Icon color index from Quire's predefined palette. Two-digit code [0-5][0-7]: first digit 0-5, second digit 0-7 (e.g. 00, 37, 57). NOT a CSS hex color.

image: string icon-view-list, icon-view-kanban, icon-grid, icon-view-timeline, icon-calendar, icon-timer, icon-briefcase-o, icon-rocket-o, icon-bug-o, icon-user-o, icon-colleagues-o, icon-lightbulb-o, icon-leaf-o, icon-clapperboard, icon-sitemap-o, icon-list, icon-flash-on-o, icon-piggy-bank-o, icon-graduation-cap-o, icon-paper-plane-o, icon-globe-o, icon-music-o, icon-detail, icon-beach-o, icon-paper, icon-home-o, icon-building, icon-database-o, icon-microscope-o, icon-hamburger-o, icon-trophy-o, icon-thumbs-o-up, icon-thumbs-o-down, icon-smile-o, icon-frown-o, icon-meh-o, icon-bullseye, icon-incomplete, icon-filter-o, icon-comment, icon-view-insight, icon-view-dashboard, icon-square-dotted-o

(Optional) Icon image identifier, one of the listed values.

name: string

Display name of the record (Markdown supported).

id: string

(Optional) ID for this record, unique among the owner's records of the same kind (e.g. a project's sublists). If omitted or invalid, Quire derives one from name; if already taken, Quire changes it by appending characters. Neither is an error, so read the id back from the response.

partner: string

(Optional) OID of the external team to share this record with; it is then shared with the members of the project and of that team, and is always private.

Only a project's record can carry one — an organization, a folder or a smart folder has no external team — and it must be one of the project's external teams; any other value is 400. It cannot be combined with members either (400).

An external team member shares a record with every member only through their own team: with members omitted or null, they must set partner to one of their teams. Otherwise 400 names their teams, as it does for a team of the project that isn't theirs.

Settable only when creating the record.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this record from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link, like a custom field's private. A choice only when members is null and partner is null; defaults to false (everyone). Otherwise it is always true: a record shared with an external team, with selected members or with the admins only is hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

members: string[]

(Optional) Users who can see this record, and the only ones it is shown to. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user.

  • Omit the field, or pass null — every member of the owner can see it, and so can guests and the visitors of a public project or of a share link unless private. This is the default. (A reminder differs: omitting its members means only the authenticated user.) An external team member must also set partner to one of their teams.
  • Pass [] — only the owner's admins can see it.
  • Pass a list — only those users can see it.

Rejected with 400 when:

  • a listed user is not a member of the owner. Unlike a task's assignees, which silently drops a non-member, this is an error: dropping the last one would leave [], which means something else entirely.
  • the list is non-empty and does not include the authenticated user — you would not be able to see what you just created.
  • partner is also set, since an external-team record is already shared with all members of the project and of the team.

Settable only when creating the record. It cannot be changed afterwards, so recreate the record to change who can see it.

Request Example
{
  "followers": "[\"me\"]",
  "description": "**Great** record to start with.",
  "iconColor": "37",
  "image": "icon-view-kanban",
  "name": "Highlight 101",
  "id": "Highlight101",
  "partner": "rcBHBYXZSiyDRrHrWPutatfF",
  "private": false,
  "members": "[\"me\", \"john\"]"
}
200 OK
Doc

OK — created doc record.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed, for example a partner that isn't an external team of the project (or any, when the owner isn't a project), or none from an external team member sharing with every member.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — document quota reached.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller lacks permission to create a doc in this owner.

404 Not Found

Not Found — owner does not exist.

Response Content-Types: application/json
Response Example (200 OK)

  "nameText": "Highlight 101",

Subject to the document-per-owner quota: may return 402 Payment Required if the plan's document limit is already reached.

in path

in path

in query

doc

Update a document by ID.

PUT /doc/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{docId}

Updates an existing document and returns the updated record.

To archive or unarchive, set archived: true or archived: false in the body.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /id/my_project/1234 is equivalent to /id/project/my_project/1234.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

docId: string
in path

Document ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full document record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

followers: string[]

(Optional) Followers (OID, ID, or email) to replace the current followers. Applies only when the owner is a project; rejected (400) for organization, folder, or smart-folder documents.

  • "me" — the current user.
  • "app" — the application follows (receives notifications).

App follower syntax: app|team, app|team|channel, or app|/path.

With read access only, addFollowers and removeFollowers may name only yourself: "me", or "app" to add the app on your behalf. Adding or removing anyone else returns 403, even along with yourself. followers replaces every follower, so it needs edit access even as ["me"]. An update that only follows or unfollows doesn't change editedAt.

addFollowers: string[]

(Optional) Followers (OID, ID, or email) to add. Adding a user also takes them off mutes.

Applies only when the owner is a project; rejected (400) for organization, folder, or smart-folder documents.

  • "me" — the current user.
  • "app" — the application follows.

App follower syntax: app|team, app|team|channel, or app|/path.

With read access only, addFollowers and removeFollowers may name only yourself: "me", or "app" to add the app on your behalf. Adding or removing anyone else returns 403, even along with yourself. followers replaces every follower, so it needs edit access even as ["me"]. An update that only follows or unfollows doesn't change editedAt.

Delete a document by ID.

DELETE /doc/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{docId}

Removes the document. Restore it with PUT /doc/undo-remove/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{docId} (or /doc/undo-remove/{oid}).

Returns 204 No Content, also when the document does not exist.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /id/my_project/1234 is equivalent to /id/project/my_project/1234.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

docId: string
in path

Document ID.

204 No Content

No Content

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller lacks permission to remove this doc.

insight

Insight views — configurable task views with filters and columns.

insight

Add a custom-field definition to an insight view by ID.

POST /insight/add-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Adds a custom-field definition to the insight view.

Only formula and lookup types are allowed on insight views; any other type returns 400, as do an invalid body and a missing name.

Requires admin rights on the insight's owner (its project, organization, folder or smart folder) and an app with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403. External-team members always get 403.

Returns the field's definition (the shape of an entry in the insight's fields) plus its name; with ?return=compact, only {"name": "…"}.

A name already in use returns 409; reaching the plan's custom-field limit returns 402.

ownerType: string project, organization, folder, smart-folder
in path

Owner type of the insight. Required here: it is not assumed to be project.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the field's definition plus its name; compact returns only {"name": "…"} (for rename, the new name). Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

currency: string

(Optional, money/formula only) Currency symbol. When omitted on a money field, defaults to $.

percent: boolean

(Optional, number only) Format the value as a percentage.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field and its values from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link. A choice only without viewMembers; with it, the field is always hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

lookup: object

(Optional, lookup only) Map from lookup key to numeric value. Keys are OIDs of the configured lookupType entity (e.g. user OIDs when lookupType=User). Values are numbers.

options: FieldOption

(Optional, select only) Options, each an object with name and an optional color — not a plain string. Example: [{"name": "High", "color": "13"}, {"name": "Low"}].

hidden: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field from the task detail panel.

clearOnDup: boolean

(Optional) Clear this field when duplicating a task.

viewMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can view this field's values; an admin not named sees the definition, not the values. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user, and must be a member of the field's owner, an external team's member included. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for everyone private allows.

editMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can edit the values, in the same form as viewMembers; an admin not named can't. Editing also requires viewing the field. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for anyone who can edit the task. locked stops editing in Quire regardless of this list; the API ignores the lock, so this list still applies to API writes.

locked: boolean

(Optional) Lock the values: no one can edit them in Quire, admins included, while the API still can, e.g., to push values from another system.

withTime: boolean

(Optional, date only) Include time-of-day in addition to the date.

ndecimal: integer -1, 0, 1, 2, 3

(Optional, number/money only) Number of decimal digits. -1 means no rounding.

durationFormat: string hh:mm:ss, hh:mm, 1h1m, 1h, 1d1h, dd:hh:mm:ss, dd:hh:mm, dd:hh

(Optional, duration/formula only) Duration display format.

formula: string

(Optional, formula only) Formula expression, at most 5,120 characters.

resultType: string text, number, money, date, duration, checkbox

(Optional, formula only) Expected result type.

lookupType: string User, Task, Project, Organization

(Optional, lookup only) Source type for lookup keys. Default: User.

multiple: boolean

(Optional) Allow multiple values. Applies to select, user, task, and file (always true for file).

conditionFormat: FieldConditionFormat

(Optional) Conditional-format rules. Applicable to date, number, money, duration, lookup, and formula fields whose resultType resolves to one of those.

name: string

Unique name for this field. Must be a non-empty string of at most 1,280 characters, and must not contain }, ", or \.

type: string text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula, file, lookup

Field type. A project's field is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file; an insight's field is formula or lookup. A key for another type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Request Example
{
  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[\"me\", \"john\"]",
  "editMembers": "[\"me\"]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,
  "durationFormat": "hh:mm",
  "formula": "SUM(Subtask.Amount)",
  "resultType": "number",
  "lookupType": "User",
  "multiple": true,
  "conditionFormat": [
    {
      "color": "42",
      "second": "200",
      "when": "today",
      "op": ">=",
      "first": "#/definitions/Number"
    }
  ],
  "name": "Priority",
  "type": "number"
}
200 OK
FieldDefinitionWithName

OK — created field definition.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — custom-field quota reached.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller is not an admin of the insight's owner, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — insight or owner does not exist.

409 Conflict

Conflict — a field with this name already exists.

Response Content-Types: application/json
Response Example (200 OK) 
{
  "name": "Priority",
  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[{\"oid\":\"iDsPd.QP_qM.hN.Trymukn8b\",\"id\":\"john\",\"name\":\"John\"}]",
  "editMembers": "[]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,
  "durationFormat": "hh:mm",
  "formula": "SUM(Subtask.Amount)",
  "resultType": "number",
  "lookupType": "User",
  "multiple": true,
  "conditionFormat": [
    {
      "color": "42",
      "second": "200",
      "when": "today",
      "op": ">=",
      "first": "#/definitions/Number"
    }
  ],
  "type": "number"
}

insight

Create an insight view by owner OID.

POST /insight/{ownerType}/{ownerOid}

Adds a new insight view to the specified owner (project, organization, folder, or smart-folder) and returns it.

Example — POST /insight/id/project/my_project:

{
  "name": "Workload",
  "image": "icon-view-insight"
}

To add formula or lookup columns, call POST /insight/add-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId} afterwards.

Returns 402 if the plan's insight limit is reached.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /abc123 is equivalent to /project/abc123.

ownerOid: string
in path

Owner OID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full insight record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

description: string

(Optional) Description of the record (Markdown supported). An embedded data: image is rejected — upload the image as an attachment instead.

iconColor: string

(Optional) Icon color index from Quire's predefined palette. Two-digit code [0-5][0-7]: first digit 0-5, second digit 0-7 (e.g. 00, 37, 57). NOT a CSS hex color.

image: string icon-view-list, icon-view-kanban, icon-grid, icon-view-timeline, icon-calendar, icon-timer, icon-briefcase-o, icon-rocket-o, icon-bug-o, icon-user-o, icon-colleagues-o, icon-lightbulb-o, icon-leaf-o, icon-clapperboard, icon-sitemap-o, icon-list, icon-flash-on-o, icon-piggy-bank-o, icon-graduation-cap-o, icon-paper-plane-o, icon-globe-o, icon-music-o, icon-detail, icon-beach-o, icon-paper, icon-home-o, icon-building, icon-database-o, icon-microscope-o, icon-hamburger-o, icon-trophy-o, icon-thumbs-o-up, icon-thumbs-o-down, icon-smile-o, icon-frown-o, icon-meh-o, icon-bullseye, icon-incomplete, icon-filter-o, icon-comment, icon-view-insight, icon-view-dashboard, icon-square-dotted-o

(Optional) Icon image identifier, one of the listed values.

name: string

Display name of the record (Markdown supported).

id: string

(Optional) ID for this record, unique among the owner's records of the same kind (e.g. a project's sublists). If omitted or invalid, Quire derives one from name; if already taken, Quire changes it by appending characters. Neither is an error, so read the id back from the response.

partner: string

(Optional) OID of the external team to share this record with; it is then shared with the members of the project and of that team, and is always private.

Only a project's record can carry one — an organization, a folder or a smart folder has no external team — and it must be one of the project's external teams; any other value is 400. It cannot be combined with members either (400).

An external team member shares a record with every member only through their own team: with members omitted or null, they must set partner to one of their teams. Otherwise 400 names their teams, as it does for a team of the project that isn't theirs.

Settable only when creating the record.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this record from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link, like a custom field's private. A choice only when members is null and partner is null; defaults to false (everyone). Otherwise it is always true: a record shared with an external team, with selected members or with the admins only is hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

members: string[]

(Optional) Users who can see this record, and the only ones it is shown to. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user.

  • Omit the field, or pass null — every member of the owner can see it, and so can guests and the visitors of a public project or of a share link unless private. This is the default. (A reminder differs: omitting its members means only the authenticated user.) An external team member must also set partner to one of their teams.
  • Pass [] — only the owner's admins can see it.
  • Pass a list — only those users can see it.

Rejected with 400 when:

  • a listed user is not a member of the owner. Unlike a task's assignees, which silently drops a non-member, this is an error: dropping the last one would leave [], which means something else entirely.
  • the list is non-empty and does not include the authenticated user — you would not be able to see what you just created.
  • partner is also set, since an external-team record is already shared with all members of the project and of the team.

Settable only when creating the record. It cannot be changed afterwards, so recreate the record to change who can see it.

  "description": "**Great** record to start with.",
  "iconColor": "37",
  "image": "icon-view-kanban",
  "name": "Highlight 101",
  "id": "Highlight101",
  "partner": "rcBHBYXZSiyDRrHrWPutatfF",
  "private": false,
  "members": "[\"me\", \"john\"]"
}
200 OK
Insight

OK — created insight record.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed, for example a partner that isn't an external team of the project (or any, when the owner isn't a project), or none from an external team member sharing with every member.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — insight quota reached.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller lacks permission to create an insight under this owner.

404 Not Found

Not Found — owner does not exist.

insight

Run an Insight and return its computed result (by ID).

GET /insight/run/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Runs the Insight and returns its computed result — one aggregated row per group, as a JSON 2D array. The Insight's formulas and its column layout (set in Quire; the layout is not exposed through the API) drive what's evaluated.

Response shape: [[<headers>], [<row>], ...]. Row 0 is the column-label header row; the first column is the synthesized group-by column (assignee for ?group-by=member, section for ?group-by=section); remaining columns are the Insight's columns as laid out in Quire, without the custom fields the caller can't view. Header labels are raw field-name strings (locale-independent), matching /task/list, /search/*, and export-json.

Example (group-by=section, two sections plus one sectionless task; score is a project number field, f1 an Insight formula field):

[
  ["section", "name", "priority", "score", "f1"],
  [{"oid":"T1","id":7,"name":"Backend"}, null, 2, 30, 63],
  [{"oid":"T2","id":8,"name":"Frontend"}, null, 1, 70, 142],
  [null, null, 2, 50, 102]
]

Row order: alphabetical by the group entity's name (case-insensitive, simple-markdown stripped); null group (unassigned / sectionless tasks) sorts last.

Aggregation per column is driven by the field's calc type (the field's default, or the calculation chosen for the column in Quire):

  • name → null (no aggregation; not applicable)
  • status → avg, priority → max
  • start → min, due / completedAt → max
  • a number, money, duration or lookup field → sum
  • a date field → max
  • a formula field → sum (default)

Cell value types (how to parse each cell):

  • text / number / boolean → as-is JSON.
  • date (start, due or a date field) → yyyy-MM-dd when it has no time, otherwise an ISO-8601 UTC datetime (2026-06-20T09:00:00Z).
  • money (a money field) → the numeric amount only (currency symbol and decimal count are dropped).
  • duration (a duration field) and time-log totals → an integer number of seconds.
  • entity (member / section / task ref) → {oid, id, name}; a user's id is a string, a task's / section's id is an integer; name is plain text (markdown stripped). Deleted-user assignees become a censored placeholder so their group stays distinct from the unassigned (null) group.
  • null → empty / not applicable (e.g. the name column on an aggregated row, or a column with no value for the group).

Project-scoped Insights only. Other owner types return 400.

Formula-token limitation: the project's task collections — project.tasks, project.activetasks, project.completedtasks (and project.subtasks, which means project.tasks) — are not supported through this endpoint, in an Insight's formula field and in a project's formula field alike. Evaluating any of them would scan every task in the project, which is deliberately not exposed on the public API. Cells that reference them render as JSON null; the rest of the row is unaffected. Workarounds:

  • Reference the row's own task fields (e.g. priority, due, or a project's number field).
  • Use the row task's subtasks (or activesubtasks / completedsubtasks) to walk its children; these are supported.

Rate-limit cost: max(1, ceil(tasks / 250)) units, where tasks is the number of tasks loaded after the ?status= filter — 1 for up to 250 tasks, 4 for 1,000. A narrower ?status= costs less. See also Rate Limits.

ownerType: string project
in path

Owner type. Only project is supported on this endpoint; other types return 400.

ownerId: string
in path

Project ID (the owner ID).

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

group-by: string member, section member
in query

(Optional) Row grouping. member produces one row per assignee (multi-assignee tasks contribute to every group their assignees are in; unassigned tasks fall into a null group). section produces one row per section ancestor (tasks not under any section fall into a null group). Case-insensitive.

status: string active, completed, all active
in query

(Optional) Task-state filter, applied at the SQL load layer (narrower queries cost less — see rate-limit note). active = not-yet-completed tasks (state < completed). completed = completed tasks. all = no filter. Case-insensitive.

200 OK

OK — JSON 2D array (header row + data rows; data rows may be empty).

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — unknown ?group-by / ?status value, or non-project-scoped Insight.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller lacks read permission on the Insight.

404 Not Found

Not Found — Insight or owner does not exist.

429 Too Many Requests

Too Many Requests — rate-limit exceeded.

Response Content-Types: application/json

List insight views by owner ID.

GET /insight/list/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}

Returns the owner's insight views that the caller can see; one shown to selected members only is left out for the others. Archived ones are included (they carry archivedAt); removed ones are not.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /list/id/foo is equivalent to /list/id/project/foo.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

200 OK
Insight

OK — list of insight records (may be empty).

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — the user can't access it, or didn't authorize it for this app.

404 Not Found

Not Found — owner does not exist.

insight

Reorder a custom-field definition on an insight view by ID.

PUT /insight/move-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Moves the named field to a new position. By default the field is moved to the end; pass &before={otherName} to place it immediately before another field.

Requires admin rights on the insight's owner (its project, organization, folder or smart folder) and an app with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403. External-team members always get 403.

Returns the field's definition (the shape of an entry in the insight's fields) plus its name; with ?return=compact, only {"name": "…"}.

A missing field, or a missing &before={otherName} field, returns 404; a missing name query parameter, 400.

ownerType: string project, organization, folder, smart-folder
in path

Owner type of the insight. Required here: it is not assumed to be project.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

name: string
in query

Name of the field to move. Percent-encode it, e.g. Billable%20Amount for Billable Amount; a + in the name must be %2B, since + means a space in a query.

before: string
in query

(Optional) Name of the field to insert before. If omitted, the field is moved to the end. Percent-encode it, e.g. Billable%20Amount for Billable Amount; a + in the name must be %2B, since + means a space in a query.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the field's definition plus its name; compact returns only {"name": "…"} (for rename, the new name). Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

200 OK
FieldDefinitionWithName

OK — moved field definition.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — name missing.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller is not an admin of the insight's owner, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — insight, owner, field or before field does not exist.

Response Content-Types: application/json
Response Example (200 OK) 
{
  "name": "Priority",
  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[{\"oid\":\"iDsPd.QP_qM.hN.Trymukn8b\",\"id\":\"john\",\"name\":\"John\"}]",
  "editMembers": "[]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,
  "durationFormat": "hh:mm",
  "formula": "SUM(Subtask.Amount)",
  "resultType": "number",
  "lookupType": "User",
  "multiple": true,
  "conditionFormat": [
    {
      "color": "42",
      "second": "200",
      "when": "today",
      "op": ">=",
      "first": "#/definitions/Number"
    }
  ],
  "type": "number"
}

insight

Rename a custom-field definition on an insight view by ID.

PUT /insight/rename-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Renames the field in place and returns the renamed field. The field's content is preserved.

Requires admin rights on the insight's owner (its project, organization, folder or smart folder) and an app with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403. External-team members always get 403.

Returns the field's definition plus its new name; with ?return=compact, only {"name": "<new name>"}.

A missing field returns 404; a new-name already in use, 409; a missing name or new-name, or an invalid new-name, 400 — new-name must be non-empty, without }, " or \, and at most 1,280 characters.

ownerType: string project, organization, folder, smart-folder
in path

Owner type of the insight. Required here: it is not assumed to be project.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

name: string
in query

Current field name. Percent-encode it, e.g. Billable%20Amount for Billable Amount; a + in the name must be %2B, since + means a space in a query.

new-name: string
in query

New field name. Percent-encode it, e.g. Billable%20Amount for Billable Amount; a + in the name must be %2B, since + means a space in a query.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the field's definition plus its name; compact returns only {"name": "…"} (for rename, the new name). Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

200 OK
FieldDefinitionWithName

OK — renamed field definition.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — name or new-name missing, or new-name invalid.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller is not an admin of the insight's owner, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — insight, owner or field does not exist.

409 Conflict

Conflict — new-name is already in use.

Undo the removal of an insight view by ID.

PUT /insight/undo-remove/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Restores a previously-removed insight view. Idempotent: if the insight is not currently removed, this is a no-op and returns the current insight record.

Subject to the insight-per-owner quota: may return 402 Payment Required if the plan's insight limit is already reached.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /undo-remove/id/foo/bar is equivalent to /undo-remove/id/project/foo/bar.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full insight record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

200 OK
Insight

OK — restored insight record.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — insight quota reached.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller lacks permission to restore this insight.

404 Not Found

Not Found — insight or owner does not exist.

insight

Update a custom-field definition on an insight view by ID.

PUT /insight/update-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Updates the content of an existing custom field of the insight view.

type is immutable — if supplied, it must match the existing type, or 400. Keys that are omitted leave their current values intact, and so does each boolean option you omit or send as null (hidden, locked, private, …): they are merged one by one, not replaced as a set. An invalid body or a missing name query parameter returns 400; a missing field, 404.

Requires admin rights on the insight's owner (its project, organization, folder or smart folder) and an app with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403. External-team members always get 403.

Returns the field's definition (the shape of an entry in the insight's fields) plus its name; with ?return=compact, only {"name": "…"}.

To rename a field, use /insight/rename-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}?name={fieldName}&new-name={newName}; to reorder, use /insight/move-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}?name={fieldName}. (The /{oid} URL form, e.g. /insight/rename-field/{oid}?…, is also accepted.)

ownerType: string project, organization, folder, smart-folder
in path

Owner type of the insight. Required here: it is not assumed to be project.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

name: string
in query

Name of the field to update. Percent-encode it, e.g. Billable%20Amount for Billable Amount; a + in the name must be %2B, since + means a space in a query.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the field's definition plus its name; compact returns only {"name": "…"} (for rename, the new name). Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

currency: string

(Optional, money/formula only) Currency symbol. Pass $ to reset a money field to its default.

percent: boolean

(Optional, number only) Format the value as a percentage.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field and its values from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link. A choice only without viewMembers; with it, the field is always hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

lookup: object

(Optional, lookup only) Map from lookup key to numeric value. Keys are OIDs of the configured lookupType entity. Replaces the entire map.

options: UpdateFieldOption

(Optional, select only) Replacement option list, each an object with name, an optional color, and an optional from. It replaces the entire set; [] removes every option. To rename an option, give its current name in from, e.g. {"name": "Critical", "from": "High"}; tasks set to it get the new name. Without from, nothing is treated as a rename: a current option that no entry names, in name or from, is removed, and tasks set to it lose that value. An entry without color keeps the current color of the option it matches (by from, else by name).

hidden: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field from the task detail panel.

clearOnDup: boolean

(Optional) Clear this field when duplicating a task.

viewMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can view this field's values; an admin not named sees the definition, not the values. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user, and must be a member of the field's owner, an external team's member included. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for everyone private allows.

editMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can edit the values, in the same form as viewMembers; an admin not named can't. Editing also requires viewing the field. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for anyone who can edit the task. locked stops editing in Quire regardless of this list; the API ignores the lock, so this list still applies to API writes.

locked: boolean

(Optional) Lock the values: no one can edit them in Quire, admins included, while the API still can, e.g., to push values from another system.

withTime: boolean

(Optional, date only) Include time-of-day in addition to the date.

ndecimal: integer -1, 0, 1, 2, 3

(Optional, number/money only) Number of decimal digits. -1 means no rounding.

durationFormat: string hh:mm:ss, hh:mm, 1h1m, 1h, 1d1h, dd:hh:mm:ss, dd:hh:mm, dd:hh

(Optional, duration/formula only) Duration display format.

formula: string

(Optional, formula only) Formula expression, at most 5,120 characters.

resultType: string text, number, money, date, duration, checkbox

(Optional, formula only) Expected result type.

lookupType: string User, Task, Project, Organization

(Optional, lookup only) Source type for lookup keys.

multiple: boolean

(Optional) Allow multiple values. Applies to select, user, task, and file (always true for file).

conditionFormat: FieldConditionFormat

(Optional) Replacement conditional-format rules. It replaces the entire list; [] removes every rule.

type: string text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula, file, lookup

(Optional) Field type. Immutable on update — if supplied, must match the existing field's type. Usually omitted; include only to verify the stored type. A project's field is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file; an insight's field is formula or lookup. A key for another type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Request Example

  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "from": "High",
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[\"me\", \"john\"]",
  "editMembers": "[\"me\"]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,
  "durationFormat": "hh:mm",
  "formula": "SUM(Subtask.Amount)",
  "resultType": "number",
  "lookupType": "User",
  "multiple": true,
  "conditionFormat": [
    {
      "color": "42",
      "second": "200",
      "when": "today",
      "op": ">=",
      "first": "#/definitions/Number"
    }
  ],
  "type": "number"
}

FieldDefinitionWithName

OK — updated field definition.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed, or name missing.

Forbidden — caller is not an admin of the insight's owner, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

insight

Update a custom-field definition on an insight view.

PUT /insight/update-field/{oid}

Updates the content of an existing custom field of the insight view.

type is immutable — if supplied, it must match the existing type, or 400. Keys that are omitted leave their current values intact, and so does each boolean option you omit or send as null (hidden, locked, private, …): they are merged one by one, not replaced as a set. An invalid body or a missing name query parameter returns 400; a missing field, 404.

Requires admin rights on the insight's owner (its project, organization, folder or smart folder) and an app with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403. External-team members always get 403.

Returns the field's definition (the shape of an entry in the insight's fields) plus its name; with ?return=compact, only {"name": "…"}.

To rename a field, use /insight/rename-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}?name={fieldName}&new-name={newName}; to reorder, use /insight/move-field/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}?name={fieldName}. (The /{oid} URL form, e.g. /insight/rename-field/{oid}?…, is also accepted.)

oid: string
in path

Insight OID.

name: string
in query

Name of the field to update. Percent-encode it, e.g. Billable%20Amount for Billable Amount; a + in the name must be %2B, since + means a space in a query.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the field's definition plus its name; compact returns only {"name": "…"} (for rename, the new name). Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

currency: string

(Optional, money/formula only) Currency symbol. Pass $ to reset a money field to its default.

percent: boolean

(Optional, number only) Format the value as a percentage.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field and its values from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link. A choice only without viewMembers; with it, the field is always hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

lookup: object

(Optional, lookup only) Map from lookup key to numeric value. Keys are OIDs of the configured lookupType entity. Replaces the entire map.

options: UpdateFieldOption

(Optional, select only) Replacement option list, each an object with name, an optional color, and an optional from. It replaces the entire set; [] removes every option. To rename an option, give its current name in from, e.g. {"name": "Critical", "from": "High"}; tasks set to it get the new name. Without from, nothing is treated as a rename: a current option that no entry names, in name or from, is removed, and tasks set to it lose that value. An entry without color keeps the current color of the option it matches (by from, else by name).

hidden: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field from the task detail panel.

clearOnDup: boolean

(Optional) Clear this field when duplicating a task.

viewMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can view this field's values; an admin not named sees the definition, not the values. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user, and must be a member of the field's owner, an external team's member included. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for everyone private allows.

editMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can edit the values, in the same form as viewMembers; an admin not named can't. Editing also requires viewing the field. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for anyone who can edit the task. locked stops editing in Quire regardless of this list; the API ignores the lock, so this list still applies to API writes.

locked: boolean

(Optional) Lock the values: no one can edit them in Quire, admins included, while the API still can, e.g., to push values from another system.

withTime: boolean

(Optional, date only) Include time-of-day in addition to the date.

ndecimal: integer -1, 0, 1, 2, 3

(Optional, number/money only) Number of decimal digits. -1 means no rounding.

durationFormat: string hh:mm:ss, hh:mm, 1h1m, 1h, 1d1h, dd:hh:mm:ss, dd:hh:mm, dd:hh

(Optional, duration/formula only) Duration display format.

formula: string

(Optional, formula only) Formula expression, at most 5,120 characters.

resultType: string text, number, money, date, duration, checkbox

(Optional, formula only) Expected result type.

lookupType: string User, Task, Project, Organization

(Optional, lookup only) Source type for lookup keys.

multiple: boolean

(Optional) Allow multiple values. Applies to select, user, task, and file (always true for file).

conditionFormat: FieldConditionFormat

(Optional) Replacement conditional-format rules. It replaces the entire list; [] removes every rule.

type: string text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula, file, lookup

(Optional) Field type. Immutable on update — if supplied, must match the existing field's type. Usually omitted; include only to verify the stored type. A project's field is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file; an insight's field is formula or lookup. A key for another type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Request Example
{
  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "from": "High",
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[\"me\", \"john\"]",
  "editMembers": "[\"me\"]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,
  "durationFormat": "hh:mm",
  "formula": "SUM(Subtask.Amount)",
  "resultType": "number",
  "lookupType": "User",
  "multiple": true,
  "conditionFormat": [
    {
      "color": "42",
      "second": "200",
      "when": "today",
      "op": ">=",
      "first": "#/definitions/Number"
    }
  ],
  "type": "number"
}
200 OK
FieldDefinitionWithName

OK — updated field definition.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed, or name missing.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller is not an admin of the insight's owner, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — insight or field does not exist.

Update an insight view by ID.

PUT /insight/id/{ownerType}/{ownerId}/{insightId}

Updates an existing insight view and returns the updated record.

To archive or unarchive, set archived: true or archived: false in the body.

ownerType: string
in path

Owner type. One of project, organization, folder, or smart-folder. If omitted, project is assumed; e.g., /id/my_project/insight1 is equivalent to /id/project/my_project/insight1.

ownerId: string
in path

Owner ID.

insightId: string
in path

Insight ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) returns the full insight record; compact returns only {"oid": "…", "id": "…"}, which is cheaper — use it when you don't need the record back. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this record from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link, like a custom field's private. A choice only when members is null and partner is null; otherwise it is always true, and false is rejected with 400.

description: string

(Optional) New description for this record (Markdown supported). An embedded data: image is rejected — upload the image as an attachment instead.

iconColor: string

(Optional) Icon color index from Quire's predefined palette. Two-digit code [0-5][0-7]: first digit 0-5, second digit 0-7 (e.g. 00, 37, 57). NOT a CSS hex color.

image: string icon-view-list, icon-view-kanban, icon-grid, icon-view-timeline, icon-calendar, icon-timer, icon-briefcase-o, icon-rocket-o, icon-bug-o, icon-user-o, icon-colleagues-o, icon-lightbulb-o, icon-leaf-o, icon-clapperboard, icon-sitemap-o, icon-list, icon-flash-on-o, icon-piggy-bank-o, icon-graduation-cap-o, icon-paper-plane-o, icon-globe-o, icon-music-o, icon-detail, icon-beach-o, icon-paper, icon-home-o, icon-building, icon-database-o, icon-microscope-o, icon-hamburger-o, icon-trophy-o, icon-thumbs-o-up, icon-thumbs-o-down, icon-smile-o, icon-frown-o, icon-meh-o, icon-bullseye, icon-incomplete, icon-filter-o, icon-comment, icon-view-insight, icon-view-dashboard, icon-square-dotted-o

(Optional) Icon image for this record, one of the listed values.

archived: boolean

(Optional) Archive toggle. Specify true to archive this record; specify false to unarchive.

name: string

(Optional) New display name for this record.

id: string

(Optional) New ID for this record, unique among the owner's records of the same kind. If invalid, Quire derives one from the name; if already taken, Quire changes it by appending characters. Neither is an error, so read the id back from the response.

  "id": "Highlight101"

Requires admin rights on the insight's owner (its project, organization, folder or smart folder) and an app with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403. External-team members always get 403.

in path

in path

204 No Content

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — name missing.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — caller is not an admin of the insight's owner, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

notification

Send a notification to the user who authorized this app, or to their colleagues. Typically used to surface errors, alerts, or events worth flagging in Quire's notification panel.

notification

Send a notification.

POST /notification

Sends a notification to the authorizing user (default) or to a list of recipients — the authorizing user and/or their colleagues — specified via recipients.

Eligible recipients are the authorizing user plus the colleagues this app can see — the same set returned by GET /user/list: when the user granted the app access to contacts, all colleagues are visible; otherwise only colleagues who also authorized this app.

An entry that does not exist or is not visible is rejected with 404 Not Found. The response is identical for every such case so the endpoint cannot be used to probe user existence or colleague relationships.

The app needs the Manage notifications permission, granted when the user authorized it; otherwise 403.

Rate-limit cost: one unit per 10 recipients, rounded up (at least 1), counted from the resolved list — so ["*"] costs one unit per 10 users visible to the app. It is charged only once the recipients resolve, so a call rejected with 404 costs nothing. It is counted against the organization of the user's best plan (a trial doesn't count); a user in no organization has a bucket of their own, at the Free plan's limits.

Returns 204 No Content.

url: string

(Optional) URL associated with the message. When provided, the client may render the message as a hyperlink.

A javascript: URL is rejected with 400. Without a scheme, such as example.com/sync, https:// is assumed; a path starting with / points into Quire.

recipients: string[]

(Optional) Recipients of the notification (OID, ID, or email of a user). Omit or send an empty list to notify only the authorizing user (default).

Each entry must be the authorizing user or a colleague visible to this app — exactly the set returned by GET /user/list. Entries that do not exist or are not visible are rejected with 404 Not Found; the response is identical regardless of the reason, so this endpoint cannot be used to probe whether a user exists.

Special value:

  • ["*"] — broadcast to every user visible to this app (same set as GET /user/list, including the authorizing user). * must be the sole entry; mixing it with other entries returns 400 Bad Request.

Rate-limit cost: one unit per 10 recipients, rounded up (at least 1), counted after * is expanded. A call made once the caller's per-minute or per-hour API budget is used up is rejected with 429 Too Many Requests and no notification is sent.

message: string

Notification message. Required; an empty one is rejected with 400.

Request Example
{
  "url": "https://superheros.com/sync",
  "recipients": "[\"bob@example.com\"]",
  "message": "Unable to synchronize"
}
204 No Content

No Content — notification accepted and queued for delivery.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — message is missing or empty, url is a javascript: URL, recipients is not a list, or * was combined with other entries.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — the app wasn't granted the Manage notifications permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — one or more entries in recipients do not exist or are not visible to this app.

429 Too Many Requests

Too Many Requests — the caller's per-minute or per-hour API budget is used up. No notification is sent.

Response Content-Types: application/json

organization

Update an organization by ID.

PUT /organization/id/{id}

Updates an existing organization and returns the complete updated record. Omitted body fields are left unchanged.

Who may change what: name and description need an admin of the organization, and an app with the Manage profiles permission. followers, addFollowers and removeFollowers need edit access to the organization itself (being a member of one of its projects isn't enough), and an app with the Manage tasks permission — even for only "me": unlike a project, an organization can't be followed with read access. A body mixing them needs the rights of each; otherwise 403.

id: string
in path

Organization ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) for the full organization record, or compact for just {"oid": …, "id": …}. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

description: string

(Optional) New description for this organization (Markdown supported). An embedded data: image is rejected — upload the image as an attachment instead. Needs an admin of the organization.

followers: string[]

(Optional) Followers to replace the current followers of this organization (OID, ID, or email). This replaces all existing followers. To modify incrementally, use addFollowers or removeFollowers.

Accepts the same special values as addFollowers: "me" (the current user) and "app" / "app|team" / "app|team|channel" / "app|/path" (the application).

Needs edit access to the organization, even for only "me": unlike a project, an organization can't be followed with read access.

addFollowers: string[]

(Optional) Followers to add to this organization (OID, ID, or email). Special values:

  • "me": the current user follows the organization
  • "app": the application follows (receives notifications)

App follower syntax:

  • app|team or app|team|channel
  • app|/path → appended to the hook URL when invoking the registered hook. Example: hook https://super.app/hooks/standard + follower app|/soc1/33456/a7 → https://super.app/hooks/standard/soc1/33456/a7

Needs edit access to the organization, even for only "me": unlike a project, an organization can't be followed with read access.

removeFollowers: string[]

(Optional) Followers to remove from this organization (OID, ID, or email). Accepts the same special values as addFollowers: "me" (the current user) and "app" / "app|team" / "app|team|channel" / "app|/path" (the application).

Needs edit access to the organization, even for only "me": unlike a project, an organization can't be followed with read access.

name: string

(Optional) New display name for this organization (Markdown supported). Needs an admin of the organization.

Request Example
{
  "description": "**Great** organization to start with.",
  "followers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "addFollowers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "removeFollowers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "My Organization"
}
200 OK
Organization

OK — updated organization record.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — the user lacks the role, or the app the permission, a given field needs: an admin and Manage profiles for name and description; edit access and Manage tasks for the followers.

404 Not Found

Not Found — organization does not exist.

Response Content-Types: application/json
Response Example (200 OK)

  "url": "https://quire.io/c/my_organization",
  "email": "info@company.com",
  "nameHtml": "My Organization",
  "nameText": "My Organization",
  "name": "My Organization",
  "id": "my_organization",
  "website": "https://coolwebsites.com",
  "description": "This is *cool*!",
  "descriptionHtml": "This is <i>cool</i>!",
  "descriptionText": "This is cool!",
  "iconColor": "37",

project

A project represents a prioritized list of tasks in Quire. It belongs to a single organization and is accessible to a subset of users in that organization, depending on its permissions.

project

Add an approval category to a project by ID.

POST /project/add-appv-cat/id/{id}

Adds an approval category to the project and returns it. A project always has the default category (id ""); add more to give each its own claimers and approvers.

Requires a user who is an admin of the project, and an app authorized with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403.

Example:

{
  "id": "legal",
  "name": "Legal review",
  "approvers": ["iDsPd.QP_qM.hN.Trymukn8b"]
}

claimers and approvers are lists of user OIDs; omit them or pass null for anyone, [] for the project's admins only.

An id already in use in the project returns 409; a plan without multiple approval categories, 402.

id: string
in path

Project ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) for the category, or compact for just {"id": …}. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

claimers: string[]

(Optional) Users allowed to request approval in this category.

  • Omit or null: anyone can request.
  • [] (empty list): admins only.
  • List of user OIDs: those specific users.
approvers: string[]

(Optional) Users allowed to approve, reject, or request changes in this category.

  • Omit or null: anyone can respond.
  • [] (empty list): admins only.
  • List of user OIDs: those specific users.
name: string

Display name.

id: string

Category identifier (URL-safe). Must be unique within the project. The identifier "" is reserved for the implicit default category.

Request Example
{
  "claimers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "approvers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "Legal Review",
  "id": "legal"
}
200 OK
AppvCat

OK — created approval category.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — the plan doesn't include multiple approval categories.

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — the user isn't an admin of the project, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — project does not exist.

409 Conflict

Conflict — a category with this id already exists.

Response Content-Types: application/json
Response Example (200 OK) 
{
  "name": "Legal Review",
  "id": "legal",
  "claimers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "approvers": [
    "string"
  ],
  "claimerRefs": [
    {
      "id": "my_id",
      "oid": "Dyh2YkFcu9uLgLFIeN1kB4Ld"
    }
  ],
  "approverRefs": [
    "#/definitions/SimpleEntityWithId"
  ],
  "createdAt": "2026-04-24T10:00:00.000Z",
  "createdBy": {
    "url": "https://quire.io/u/my_id",
    "id": "my_id",
    "iconColor": "37",
    "image": "https://quire.s3.amazonaws.com/oid/image.jpg",
    "name": "Foo",
    "oid": "Dyh2YkFcu9uLgLFIeN1kB4Ld"
  }
}

project

Add a custom-field definition to a project by ID.

POST /project/add-field/id/{id}

Adds a custom-field definition to the project and returns it as in Project.fields, plus its name.

Requires a user who is an admin of the project, and an app authorized with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403.

A project field's type is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file (lookup is for insights only). A key that doesn't apply to the type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Example — a single-select field with three options; each option is an object, not a plain string:

{
  "name": "Stage",
  "type": "select",
  "options": [
    {"name": "Todo"},
    {"name": "Review", "color": "13"},
    {"name": "Done", "color": "42"}
  ]
}

A name already in use returns 409; a field over the plan's custom-field limit returns 402.

id: string
in path

Project ID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) for the field definition, or compact for just {"name": …}. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

currency: string

(Optional, money/formula only) Currency symbol. When omitted on a money field, defaults to $.

percent: boolean

(Optional, number only) Format the value as a percentage.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field and its values from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link. A choice only without viewMembers; with it, the field is always hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

lookup: object

(Optional, lookup only) Map from lookup key to numeric value. Keys are OIDs of the configured lookupType entity (e.g. user OIDs when lookupType=User). Values are numbers.

options: FieldOption

(Optional, select only) Options, each an object with name and an optional color — not a plain string. Example: [{"name": "High", "color": "13"}, {"name": "Low"}].

hidden: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field from the task detail panel.

clearOnDup: boolean

(Optional) Clear this field when duplicating a task.

viewMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can view this field's values; an admin not named sees the definition, not the values. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user, and must be a member of the field's owner, an external team's member included. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for everyone private allows.

editMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can edit the values, in the same form as viewMembers; an admin not named can't. Editing also requires viewing the field. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for anyone who can edit the task. locked stops editing in Quire regardless of this list; the API ignores the lock, so this list still applies to API writes.

locked: boolean

(Optional) Lock the values: no one can edit them in Quire, admins included, while the API still can, e.g., to push values from another system.

withTime: boolean

(Optional, date only) Include time-of-day in addition to the date.

ndecimal: integer -1, 0, 1, 2, 3

(Optional, number/money only) Number of decimal digits. -1 means no rounding.

durationFormat: string hh:mm:ss, hh:mm, 1h1m, 1h, 1d1h, dd:hh:mm:ss, dd:hh:mm, dd:hh

(Optional, duration/formula only) Duration display format.

formula: string

(Optional, formula only) Formula expression, at most 5,120 characters.

resultType: string text, number, money, date, duration, checkbox

(Optional, formula only) Expected result type.

lookupType: string User, Task, Project, Organization

(Optional, lookup only) Source type for lookup keys. Default: User.

multiple: boolean

(Optional) Allow multiple values. Applies to select, user, task, and file (always true for file).

conditionFormat: FieldConditionFormat

(Optional) Conditional-format rules. Applicable to date, number, money, duration, lookup, and formula fields whose resultType resolves to one of those.

name: string

Unique name for this field. Must be a non-empty string of at most 1,280 characters, and must not contain }, ", or \.

type: string text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula, file, lookup

Field type. A project's field is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file; an insight's field is formula or lookup. A key for another type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Request Example
{
  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[\"me\", \"john\"]",
  "editMembers": "[\"me\"]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,

project

Add a custom-field definition to a project.

POST /project/add-field/{oid}

Adds a custom-field definition to the project and returns it as in Project.fields, plus its name.

Requires a user who is an admin of the project, and an app authorized with the Manage profiles permission; otherwise 403.

A project field's type is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file (lookup is for insights only). A key that doesn't apply to the type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Example — a single-select field with three options; each option is an object, not a plain string:

{
  "name": "Stage",
  "type": "select",
  "options": [
    {"name": "Todo"},
    {"name": "Review", "color": "13"},
    {"name": "Done", "color": "42"}
  ]
}

A name already in use returns 409; a field over the plan's custom-field limit returns 402.

oid: string
in path

Project OID.

return: string full, compact
in query

(Optional) Response shape: full (default) for the field definition, or compact for just {"name": …}. Any other value returns 400 Bad Request.

currency: string

(Optional, money/formula only) Currency symbol. When omitted on a money field, defaults to $.

percent: boolean

(Optional, number only) Format the value as a percentage.

private: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field and its values from guests and from the visitors of a public project or of a share link. A choice only without viewMembers; with it, the field is always hidden from them, so false is rejected with 400.

lookup: object

(Optional, lookup only) Map from lookup key to numeric value. Keys are OIDs of the configured lookupType entity (e.g. user OIDs when lookupType=User). Values are numbers.

options: FieldOption

(Optional, select only) Options, each an object with name and an optional color — not a plain string. Example: [{"name": "High", "color": "13"}, {"name": "Low"}].

hidden: boolean

(Optional) Hide this field from the task detail panel.

clearOnDup: boolean

(Optional) Clear this field when duplicating a task.

viewMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can view this field's values; an admin not named sees the definition, not the values. Each entry is a user ID, OID, or email, or "me" for the authenticated user, and must be a member of the field's owner, an external team's member included. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for everyone private allows.

editMembers: string[]

(Optional) Users who can edit the values, in the same form as viewMembers; an admin not named can't. Editing also requires viewing the field. Pass [] for the admins only, or null for anyone who can edit the task. locked stops editing in Quire regardless of this list; the API ignores the lock, so this list still applies to API writes.

locked: boolean

(Optional) Lock the values: no one can edit them in Quire, admins included, while the API still can, e.g., to push values from another system.

withTime: boolean

(Optional, date only) Include time-of-day in addition to the date.

ndecimal: integer -1, 0, 1, 2, 3

(Optional, number/money only) Number of decimal digits. -1 means no rounding.

durationFormat: string hh:mm:ss, hh:mm, 1h1m, 1h, 1d1h, dd:hh:mm:ss, dd:hh:mm, dd:hh

(Optional, duration/formula only) Duration display format.

formula: string

(Optional, formula only) Formula expression, at most 5,120 characters.

resultType: string text, number, money, date, duration, checkbox

(Optional, formula only) Expected result type.

lookupType: string User, Task, Project, Organization

(Optional, lookup only) Source type for lookup keys. Default: User.

multiple: boolean

(Optional) Allow multiple values. Applies to select, user, task, and file (always true for file).

conditionFormat: FieldConditionFormat

(Optional) Conditional-format rules. Applicable to date, number, money, duration, lookup, and formula fields whose resultType resolves to one of those.

name: string

Unique name for this field. Must be a non-empty string of at most 1,280 characters, and must not contain }, ", or \.

type: string text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula, file, lookup

Field type. A project's field is one of text, number, money, date, duration, select, checkbox, user, task, hyperlink, email, formula and file; an insight's field is formula or lookup. A key for another type, such as options on a number field, returns 400.

Request Example
{
  "currency": "USD",
  "percent": false,
  "private": false,
  "lookup": "object",
  "options": [
    {
      "color": "13",
      "name": "High"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": false,
  "clearOnDup": false,
  "viewMembers": "[\"me\", \"john\"]",
  "editMembers": "[\"me\"]",
  "locked": false,
  "withTime": false,
  "ndecimal": 2,
  "durationFormat": "hh:mm",
  "formula": "SUM(Subtask.Amount)",
  "resultType": "number",
  "lookupType": "User",
  "multiple": true,
  "conditionFormat": [
    {
      "color": "42",
      "second": "200",
      "when": "today",
      "op": ">=",
      "first": "#/definitions/Number"
    }
  ],
  "name": "Priority",
  "type": "number"
}
200 OK
FieldDefinitionWithName

OK — created custom-field definition.

400 Bad Request

Bad Request — body validation failed.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — plan's custom-field limit is reached (code 469).

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — the user isn't an admin of the project, or the app lacks the Manage profiles permission.

404 Not Found

Not Found — project does not exist.

409 Conflict

Conflict — a field with this name already exists.

Response Example (200 OK)

project

Export a project to CSV by ID.

GET /project/export-csv/id/{id}

Returns a CSV string containing the project, tasks, and related data. Columns are separated by ,, or by ; if the user's locale uses a decimal comma (e.g. de, fr).

Available on the Professional plan and above; on a lower plan it returns 402 (code 469). Guests, and the visitors of a public project, can't export it (403).

Rate-limit cost: 5 + max(1, ceil(tasks / 100)) units, where tasks counts only the tasks matching ?status=, not the project total — e.g. 6 for 100 tasks, 15 for 1,000. It applies only to an export that runs: one rejected with 402 for the plan costs 1 unit, like any call. See also Rate Limits.

id: string
in path

Project ID.

status: string
in query

Task status filter. Use active for active tasks, completed for completed tasks, or all for all tasks. Default: all.

merge: boolean
in query

Whether to merge multiple values of the same header into one column (e.g., all tags in a single column). Default: false.

200 OK

OK — CSV export of project.

402 Payment Required

Payment Required — the plan doesn't include export (code 469).

403 Forbidden

Forbidden — the user can't access the project, or is a guest.

404 Not Found

Not Found — project does not exist.

Response Content-Types: text/csv
Response Example (200 OK) 
"ID",Name,Status,Started,Completed,Priority,Start,Due,Assignee,Tag,Created,Created by,Description
#6,Task A,In Progress,"Mar 8, 2022",,Medium,,"Mar 8, 2022",,,"Mar 7, 2022",John,
"#6, #8",Task A1,To-Do,"Jan 24, 2022",,Urgent,,,,,"Mar 7, 2022",John,
#7,Task B,In Progress,"Jan 24, 2022",,Urgent,,"Mar 4, 2022",,,"Mar 7, 2022",John,
"#7, #9",Task B1,In Progress,"Jan 24, 2022",,Medium,,,,,"Mar 7, 2022",John,
"#7, #4",Task B2,In Progress,"Mar 2, 2022",,Medium,,"Mar 8, 2022",,,"Mar 2, 2022",John,
